codeReview.summary: Fail with one blocking issue. The feature correctly adds first-class `flux node resolve-gateway`, `use-gateway`, and `use-base-url`, preserves the read-only gateway-resolution path, keeps failed gateway pinning from clobbering the saved base URL, and carries gateway-auth pinning through later commands when a matching cached direct-node credential exists. However, the persisted base-URL switch helper keeps the previous node's auth and enterprise material when the target URL has no cached entry, so `use-base-url`/`use-gateway` can report and reuse stale credentials for a different node. That means the per-base-url credential-adoption contract is not fully met for VAL-NODE-003, even though VAL-NODE-001, VAL-NODE-002, and VAL-CROSS-003 are otherwise covered by the implementation and tests.

issues.description: `switchPersistedProfileBaseUrl` falls back to `current.zelidauth` / `current.enterpriseKey` when the target base URL has no cached entry. Because all base-URL-changing paths call this helper (`fluxos-cli/src/cli.ts:959`, `968`, `1013`, `2495`), switching to an uncached node can leave the previous node's auth and enterprise credentials marked active instead of clearing them. That breaks the per-base-url credential-adoption contract for `flux node use-base-url` in VAL-NODE-003 and can mislead later direct-node commands into thinking the new base URL already has matching cached credentials.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared mission docs do not record that CLI profile state now carries per-base-url auth and enterprise-key caches, even though this feature depends on those caches for gateway pinning and direct-node reuse.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `fluxos-cli/src/state/sessionState.ts:20-25` and `317-355` add `zelidauthByBaseUrl` / `enterpriseKeyByBaseUrl` plus base-url-switch helpers, while `.factory/library/environment.md:15-20` documents state-directory and env-backed profile rules but not the new cache semantics. `issue3.md:30-44` also shows this was a recurring discovery area (`cache zelidauth per node`).

summary: Fail. I reviewed the feature spec, validation contract scope, handoff, transcript skeleton, commit diff, CLI skill guidance, and the relevant CLI/MCP node-auth state code for `m3-node-resolution-and-base-url-helpers`. The implementation satisfies the read-only resolve-gateway flow, safe gateway pinning, and gateway-auth reuse checks overall, but a stale-credential fallback in persisted base-url switching means VAL-NODE-003 is not fully satisfied when the target URL has no matching cached credentials.
